lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A sequence of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters is visible posterior to the branchial slits, forming a semi-regular grid where spot diameter and spacing increase along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with highlight on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A large aggregation of small, fusiform fish is clustered in the lower-left quadrant of the frame, positioned ventrally to the shark's head and pectoral fin.
